scripts.build: npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix sea-kart && npm run build --prefix sea-kart && npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix seakart-admin && npm run build --prefix seakart-admin && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('sea-kart/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); require('fs').cpSync('seakart-admin/dist', 'dist/admin', {recursive: true})"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix sea-kart -- --open" "npm run dev --prefix seakart-admin -- --open"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix sea-kart && npm install --prefix seakart-admin
